name: Catanzaro (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Catanzaro (a crown above three hills on red) on a brown eagle beneath a crown, with the motto SANGUINIS EFFUSIONE on a ribbon.
history: Municipal flag of Catanzaro, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 30 May 1940.

features.role: Catanzaro arms — crown above three hills on red, on an eagle, crowned, with motto SANGUINIS EFFUSIONE
